exposure: Method of fetal weight estimation (3D fractional thigh volume vs. Hadlock's formula)
cohort: The study included 125 pregnant women with gestational diabetes mellitus who underwent ultrasound examination at 34 to 36 + 6 weeks' gestation.
finding: In women with gestational diabetes, the three-dimensional fractional thigh volume method, using gestation-adjusted projection, provided a more accurate estimation of birth weight compared to the standard Hadlock's formula.
